_doc: Every guest the Nano VM worker (vm-worker.js) can boot. Kept in step with core/compute_sizes.py NANO_CATALOG. 'lazy' images are fetched only when an instance of that image is first launched in a browser (never at boot); their big files are NOT in git (wasm/vm/image/<key>/ is git-ignored): build them with wasm/vm/tools/ or publish them to an image host and set base_url. kind=agent: ttyS1 command agent + dropbear; kind=console: serial shell only.
